welcome.heading: Welcome
welcome.intro: Tools for figuring out the best way to spend your Banknotes in Last Asylum: Plague, computed live from manually harvested pack data.
welcome.analyzeDescription: Pick any item and see every package or exchange offer that yields it, ranked by cost per unit, plus the cheapest purchase plan to reach a target quantity.
welcome.rankingsDescription: Browse every package, exchange offer, and bonus tier ranked by how much value it returns relative to its price, to spot the best deals at a glance.
welcome.choicesDescription: Pick a choice chest or package and see which of its reward options is worth the most, ranked by the cheapest cost to buy that same reward elsewhere.

analyze.heading: Analyze Item Value
analyze.description: Pick an item, the amount you want, how many days you're planning to buy over, and (optionally) which purchase limits may be exceeded entirely. This shows every known purchase source for that item and the cheapest purchase plan to reach your target quantity.
analyze.sourcesEmpty: No purchasable sources found for this item.
analyze.sourcesFootnote: Exchange shop prices are converted to Banknotes using the cheapest known source for their currency item.
analyze.planEmpty: No purchasable sources found for this item.
analyze.planWarning: Warning: target quantity not fully reachable using known sources within purchase limits. Missing ~{remaining} unit(s).
analyze.detailsIntro: Shop packages needed to buy the {currency} currency for this row:

rankings.heading: Value Ranking
rankings.description: Every package and shop exchange offer (including bonus tiers), ranked by how much value it provides relative to its price. Higher "Value Ratio" means a better deal. Click a row to see its full contents breakdown.
rankings.note: Value ratio = total value / price. Higher value ratio means more relative value for the Banknotes spent; entries marked incomplete contain at least one item with no known purchasable source, so total value is a lower-bound estimate.

choices.heading: Best Choice Pick
choices.description: Pick a choice chest or package (something that lets you select one or more rewards from a pool). Its options are ranked below by how much it would cost to buy that same reward elsewhere — the higher the value, the better the pick.
choices.optionsDescription: Each option is priced by what it would cost to buy that same reward through the cheapest other package or exchange offer. Ranked highest per-unit price first — that's the option worth picking.
choices.selectCountHintPartial: You can pick {count} of these {total} options — the top {count} above are the best picks.
choices.selectCountHintAll: You get all {total} of these options, so there's nothing to prioritize between them.
choices.optionsEmpty: This item has no choice options.
